Priya - Infra: Vendor updated lead times for H100s. 40 units pushed; they can air-split 15 earlier but need vendor-direct RMA for DOA. Any objections?
Sam (Procurement): Early split adds +$500 expedite + 2.5% freight. Vendor will cover brokerage.
Iris - Logistics: Early AWB 881-5550001 for 15, backfill AWB 881-5550002 for rest. Staging free 48h then $20/day/unit.
Priya - Infra: We only have ~10 staging slots this week. If 15 land, need third-party dock or delay plug-in. Confirm onboarding window?
Iris - Logistics: Vendor can delay pickup by 48h to match our Tuesday onboarding. They will include per-serial QC sheets and test logs.
rma-bot: Note: vendor-direct RMA requires RMA# on the AWB. Missing number -> depot return route (+5 days).
Sam (Procurement): Vote +1 to accept split if vendor provides QC sheets and RMA# on AWB and delays pickup to Tuesday.
Priya - Infra: +1 with those conditions. Iris, coordinate dock slot and upload AWB to #vendor-invoices when ready.
Iris - Logistics: Will confirm with vendor and update in ~90m.
